Subject: A tool for your text alerts guide

Hi [Name],

Your guide to texting employees is one of the pages Google's AI Overview shows for teams that want text alerts without a developer. Your readers compare a few tools there.

TextBolt turns email from the tools a team already uses into SMS alerts, with no coding. It would give readers who live in their inbox one more option to weigh.

Would you consider adding it? Our setup page is https://textbolt.com/blog/how-to-set-up-text-alerts-for-business/.

Thanks for reading,
[Your name]
items.detail: Their readers want alerts without a developer, which is what the page offers.
